name: Sessa Sheet Metal Contractors Inc
old_description: Established in 1980, Sessa Sheet Metal is an industry leader, delivering innovative, state-of-the-art sheet metal solutions to a diverse range of clients.
about:
Sessa Sheet Metal Contractors Inc. has operated from Baltimore, Maryland since its founding in 1980 by Thomas Sessa. After 16 years in the sheet metal trade, Sessa launched the company with a goal of building a 25-person operation; today it is an employee-owned business led by CEO Tom Sessa and President Bobby Sigmon.

The company provides full-service sheet metal contracting, including drafting, HVAC system analysis, estimating, and design-build project delivery. Its 32,000-square-foot fabrication shop runs a six-station coil line capable of producing 60-inch duct joints at a rate of one joint every 26 seconds, complemented by two double-table plasma machines, CNC brake bending, welding, layout, cutting, and sealing departments.

Sessa serves commercial, industrial, and institutional customers across the Mid-Atlantic region, delivering custom ductwork, fittings, and HVAC systems for projects ranging from office buildings to manufacturing plants.

The firm attributes its longevity to its employee-ownership model, which it says drives craftsmanship, safety, and long-term client relationships. Its mission emphasizes precision, professionalism, and empowering employee-owners to innovate on every project.
